blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Several states and major cities underwent official renaming, such as Madras to Tamil Nadu and Mysore to Karnataka.
Article 1 defines India as a Union of States.
Article 2 governs the admission or establishment of new states into the Union.
Article 3 covers the formation of new states and the alteration of areas, boundaries, or names of existing states.
Article 4 provides supplemental, incidental, and consequential provisions for laws under Articles 2 and 3.
Remember the exact numerical sequence of Articles 1 through 4 as direct questions are frequently framed on this.
Distinguish between Article 2 (admission of new states) and Article 3 (reorganization/formation of existing states).
Memorize historical state/city name transitions (e.g., Orissa to Odisha, Mysore to Karnataka) for quick one-mark questions.
